title: Figure 14: Advances in Metamaterials – magnetic resonance frequency by year, 2000–2007
description: Scatter chart of magnetic resonance frequency in THz (0.01 to 1000) and corresponding wavelength against year (2000 to 2007), with colored symbols for different metamaterial designs and numbered references. Four inset electron-microscope images show fabricated structures, with scale bars of 1 mm, 200 nm and 500 nm. The caption reads "Figure 14. Advances in Metamaterials," noting that solid symbols denote negative refraction and open symbols negative magnetic response.
